monitoring.countHint: Counted once per instance selection; failover re-selection adds extra counts.

strategyConfig.recommendation: Not sure which to pick? Use "random split" - the system distributes requests across instances by weight and automatically skips failing ones.
strategyConfig.configureHint: Click the configure button to change the load balancing strategy of a single service

strategyDescriptions.random: Picks an instance at random by weight; any instance may be used
strategyDescriptions.roundRobin: Takes instances in turn by weight; spreads load most evenly
strategyDescriptions.leastConnections: Uses whichever instance has the fewest active connections; good for long-lived connections
strategyDescriptions.ipHash: The same client IP always lands on the same instance; good for session affinity
strategyDescriptions.consistentHash: Pins instances by content hash; only a few requests shift when scaling
strategyDescriptions.latency: Automatically picks the fastest instance; good when instance speeds differ a lot

messages.configUpdated: Load balancing config of service {serviceType} updated
